prompt: My amended Form 9A pleads that the Review Officer found the 7-hour break amounted to unreasonable management action and cites it as an admitted fact at Form 24 Para 37. Is that citation right? I want to make sure before I file anything else.

assertions.text: Identifies that Form 24 Response row numbers diverge from Notice paragraph numbers
States that Notice para 37 admits only the CONTENTS of the review decision, with relevance reserved on the de novo hearing
States that there is no admission anywhere of the unreasonable-management-action finding
Identifies that Notice para 2 is a non-admission and does not support the proposition either
Renders the Form 24 PDF as images rather than relying on pdftotext output
